summary: Frontend-only regression test on redesigned dark cinematic Login page. Verified data-testids present, staff & patient logins route correctly, invalid creds stay on /login with error, and 'Create an account' link navigates to /register. No unexpected console errors (only expected 401 from invalid-cred test).

issues: Background artwork image did not appear in test screenshot (likely slow remote asset load); page remains fully usable thanks to dark gradient fallback — acceptable per spec.

critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx: remote background image URL is hardcoded (line 11). Consider moving to env or hosting locally for reliability; currently non-blocking since dark overlay provides usable fallback.
Body text color 'text-slate-500/80' on dark bg for the emergency disclaimer is low-contrast; readable but borderline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login redesign functional: staff -> /internal, patient -> /portal, invalid -> error toast, go-register -> /register. Inputs readable (light text on dark). No JS errors on page load.
